+    def solve(data):
+        packages = data["packages"]
+        names = sorted(packages)
+        features = set(data.get("features", []))
+        blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+        pins = data.get("pins", {})
+        roots = data["roots"]
+        options = []
+        for name in names:
+            versions = sorted(row["version"] for row in packages[name]
+                              if row["version"] not in blocked.get(name, []) and
+                              (name not in pins or row["version"] == pins[name]))
+            options.append([None] + versions)
+
+        best_vector = None
+        best_install = None
+        for values in product(*options):
+            chosen = {name: version for name, version in zip(names, values)
+                      if version is not None}
+            if any(name not in chosen or
+                   not bounds[0] <= chosen[name] <= bounds[1]
+                   for name, bounds in roots.items()):
+                continue
+
+            rows = {name: next(row for row in packages[name]
+                               if row["version"] == version)
+                    for name, version in chosen.items()}
+            edges = {}
+            valid = True
+            for name, row in rows.items():
+                deps = []
+                for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                    feature = dep.get("feature", "")
+                    if feature and feature not in features:
+                        continue
+                    target = dep["name"]
+                    version = chosen.get(target)
+                    if version is None or not dep["min"] <= version <= dep["max"]:
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                    deps.append(target)
+                if not valid:
+                    break
+                edges[name] = deps
+            if not valid:
+                continue
+
+            reached = set()
+            active = set()
+            cyclic = False
+
+            def visit(name):
+                nonlocal cyclic
+                if name in active:
+                    cyclic = True
+                    return
+                if name in reached:
+                    return
+                active.add(name)
+                for other in edges.get(name, []):
+                    visit(other)
+                active.remove(name)
+                reached.add(name)
+
+            for name in roots:
+                visit(name)
+            if cyclic or reached != set(chosen):
+                continue
+            vector = tuple(chosen.get(name, -1) for name in names)
